what_differs: The client removed both 'Under Review' and 'Inactive' (Lina: 'it's really only active, paused, or terminated'); Joyce confirmed three statuses. WAGR-176 removed only Review and specifies four values including Inactive, and WAGR-91 designs the User-Active mapping around those four values.
suggested_action: Remove 'Inactive' from the BA Status value set in WAGR-176 (and the built picklist, if present). Update WAGR-91 so the mapping covers Active / Paused / Terminated only (Terminated = user deactivated, per WAGR-79).
